reuse.why: The local unlink is written again as a copy of the db.updateAccount field reset inside unlinkAccount instead of extracting that reset into a helper both paths share.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset block (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status set to null) is duplicated verbatim from unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: Threading the flag through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked keeps it at one entry point, but a function named assert... now performs writes (unlinking other accounts), mixing validation and mutation in one layer.

scope.why: Mostly focused on the flag; it also adds an unrelated 'Account not found' error for a missing upgrading target.

maintainability.why: The flag is threaded consistently through all six providers, but the misleadingly named assert helper with side effects and the copied unlink reset would make future changes to unlinking easy to miss here.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount (db.updateAccount field reset) instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount
